item.title: Pope responds to president’s insults: ‘I have no fear of the Trump administration’
item.summary: The president wrote that the first U.S.-born pope, who has criticized the Iran war, was “weak” and “terrible” on crime and foreign policy.

item.title: As Iran war drags on, midterm forecasts for Republicans get even worse
item.summary: The GOP was already bracing for a tough election, but with the ceasefire in doubt, gas prices are likely to stay high, and voters’ economic outlook is dismal.

item.title: Under attack by their own congressman
item.summary: Muslims in Rep. Chip Roy’s Texas district react to their Republican congressman’s campaign against Islam with concern — and eye-rolls.

item.title: Voters grill Republican lawmaker in crucial swing district on Iran war
item.summary: The conflict has animated voters in the suburban swing district of Republican Rep. Mike Lawler ahead of the midterm elections.

item.title: Peace with Iran hinges on nuclear compromise, and the two sides are miles apart
item.summary: The Trump administration has sought a moratorium on uranium enrichment of at least 20 years. Tehran’s offer would last up to five.

item.title: Orban’s defeat offers warning signs for Trump allies
item.summary: Some factors that harmed Orban may also apply to Republicans in this year’s midterm elections, say American conservatives who backed the Hungarian leader.

item.title: Lambasting Pope Leo, Trump risks alienating conservative Catholics
item.summary: Veteran church observers say an open war of words between a pope and a U.S. president is unprecedented.

item.title: Trump announces naval blockade of Iran after Islamabad talks yield no deal
item.summary: The blockade could derail a tenuous ceasefire after just five days. Vice President JD Vance said the U.S. remains open to diplomacy if Iran takes “our final and best offer.”

item.title: Ex-Pence aide Olivia Troye plans to run for Congress in Virginia as a Democrat
item.summary: She joins other former Republicans and Trump administration officials running for office as critics of the president. The district would open up if voters approve a new map.

item.title: White House says it’s boosting affordability through physician reforms
item.summary: A new report distills the Trump administration’s strategy as officials jockey to shape health care messages ahead of this year’s midterm elections.
